messages.subject: Using RStudio IDE
parts: I have an existing installation of RStudio, which uses the latest installed version of R (4.2.4) in my case.  I have just installed MRO.  How do I coax to RStudio IDE to utilize MRO?

messages.author: 61708eaa01687afb
messages.subject: Re: Using RStudio IDE
parts:
If you do not get a prompt to make MRO default version of R that R Studio uses then you can go to tools-> globaloptions, in general tab change your R version to
C:\Program Files\Microsoft\MRO\R-3.2.3
